title: Marry-Me Blueberry Pie
description: This marry-me blueberry pie recipe, accompanied by a homemade flaky pie crust, is so delicious it may elicit a marriage proposal to the talented baker.
ingredients: 2 cups blueberries, or more to taste
2 tablespoons butter, cut into small cubes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Combine self-rising flour, oil, and water in a large bowl until dough is well-mixed. Divide dough in half; roll each half into a ball. Roll out each dough ball between 2 pieces of waxed paper until flattened and about 9 inches in diameter. Peel off top piece waxed paper from 1 piece dough; flip over a pie plate and press into pie plate. Peel off remaining piece waxed paper; trim crust if needed. Set remaining dough aside.

Combine blueberries, sugar, all-purpose flour, lemon juice, and salt in a medium bowl until evenly mixed; pour into crust in pie plate. Cover filling with remaining dough; crimp edges together. Arrange butter cubes on top crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until filling is thick and crust is golden brown, about 50 minutes.

video.description: Prove your eternal worthiness with a pie that owes its greatness not only to the berry filling but to a grandmother-approved crust recipe. Make the simple crust with self-rising flour, vegetable oil and water. Divide into two balls and roll thin between two pieces of waxed paper. Mix fresh blueberries with flour, lemon juice and salt. Pour into one crust and top with the other. Dot the top with cubes of butter and bake until golden, thick and rich. Don’t forget the ice cream for true marital bliss!
